{{Quote|Your Aqualish friend has already learned the penalty for resisting Imperial law.|Dro is informed of his colleagues fate by Imperials|<ref name="The Jewel of Yavin">''[[The Jewel of Yavin]]''</ref>}}
'''Deelo''' was an [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] who worked as a street tough during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During the war, the tough was hired by the [[Defel/Legends|Defel]] [[Thief/Legends|thief]] [[Gantel Dro]] to be part of a team which aimed to steal the [[Jewel of Yavin/Legends|Jewel of Yavin]], a valuable [[Corusca gem/Legends|Corusca gem]]. The group infiltrated the [[Marus Grayson's apartment|apartment]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] where they had been informed that the [[gem]] was being kept. While there Deelo was ordered by Dro to investigate a disturbance, after which the Aqualish was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Imperial security forces. Dro was captured shortly after and discovered the whole operation had been a setup, with the man who had hired him to steal gem, [[Marus Grayson]], also being the gems owner.<ref name="The Jewel of Yavin" />

==Behind the scenes==
Deelo first appeared in ''[[The Jewel of Yavin]]'', an adventure module released in [[2014]] for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' roleplaying game. The source did not clairfy the Aqualish's [[Gender/Legends|gender]].
